headline: Two flagship upgrades merged; the free slot closed on a documented race
lede: R-TYPE grew a duelist that hunts and a carrier that answers back, and DOUBLE DRAGON's blows learned weight — then the never-dry kick for the second slot landed during a seven-minute label window and the lane stopped clean, with the crossing pinned on the open platform issue.

notes.text: R-TYPE got its first reactive enemy (#2934→#2936): the duelist tracks the nearer hull across lanes, telegraphs its gun with an eye-glow, then commits to one straight pass — four kills fold it for 300 pod-money. Carriers now answer back too (#2937→#2940): the sting interceptor breaks off the grind to punish.

DOUBLE DRAGON knockback is weight-true (#2935→#2939): authored per-move ladder divided by mass — Abobo barely rocks where a jab sends a thug five pixels — down men skid on asphalt and the stomp foot pins. Fixing it surfaced a real softlock: unbounded blowback parked a thug past camera-edge reach; the screen edge is now a wall (bounds camX±16). 242 laws, 208 named mutants.

The never-dry kick raced a claim: DD's QA hold lapsed at 11:35Z, the warden tick read it open, and the other slot claimed it three minutes before the free lane reached the claim step. Live re-derivation over all shelf titles answered NONE — the only two titles with open gaps are both inside live lanes — so the slot stopped legally and pinned the new kick-shape on #2910 for the harness fix.

Next real work is already scored and waiting: DD's whip/stick rotations and walk-to-retrieve re-arm free when #2889 ships (in build now), and R-TYPE's phase-2 volley dodge, wing-shell initiative and dark-seat life free when QA releases #2938. The free-slot ladder takes them the moment either hold lifts.
